title: Reshape
source_docs: DSP System Toolbox HDL Support/Signal Management/Convert_1_D_to_2_D.md
text: Change dimensionality of signal, 1 input, 1 output, direct feedthrough, {Output dimensionality} sets Dimensions of output signal 1-D; {Output dimensions} sets the custom dimensions of output signal. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Output dimensionality
params.values: Dimensions of output signal 1-D array (default) | Column vector (2-D) | Row vector (2-D) | Customize | Derive from reference input port
